properties.notes: Continued education/ D1 use, or subject to the satisfactory relocation of existing uses redevelopment to include permanent (C3) residential use, including affordable housing. Development will be expected to:• Make full and efficient use of this highly accessible central London location to deliver additional floorspace at a density which reflects the sites accessibility• Contribute to the supply of housing and affordable housing if educational use does not continue on site along with other appropriate uses as part of a mixed use scheme• Improve the public realm and landscaping; integrating with improvements at and around Regents Place with residential areas to the north of Longford Street• Provide infrastructure for supporting local energy generation on site and/or connections to existing or future networks where feasible
